summary: /tag still scrolled sideways in Firefox at 320/375/390: Firefox reports the stylesheet's zoom value as supported yet does not apply it, so the CSS.supports-gated fallback never ran.
fix: SheetFit measures instead of asking the engine: a Letter page still wider than its column after layout gets data-fit="js" and --sheet-k (column / page), which a stronger rule applies; print resets it to 1. Checked in Firefox 151: 0 px sideways at 320/375/390 (was 325 px at 375).
